excluded_samples.reason: Singleton lineage cannot occur in both disjoint sets.

split_design: 20 response-blind lineage-stratified identity-group holdouts. Approximately 80/20 per lineage, nearest feasible rounded sample count, at least one identity group on each side. Uniform random group subsets conditional on each sample-count target.
inner_design: Five identity-group-stratified validation folds within outer training. A lineage represented by one training identity group is always inner training (-2) and never inner validation. Thus all 23 lineages remain in every inner training set; validation has 22 lineages because Ampulla has only one outer-training line.
ampulla_handling: Two total lines: one outer train and one outer test in every repeat. Outer-training Ampulla is present in every inner fit but not inner validation; outer test is never used for tuning.

neural_fixed.prediction: average of three independently initialized networks in inner and outer fits
neural_fixed.scaling: StandardScaler for X and y fit only on the current training subset

weighting: Unweighted training in every model and every fold. NN adapter receives an exact all-ones sample-weight vector and is checked against native MLPRegressor.
tuning: Original model-specific grids; minimum unweighted equal-weight mean of five inner-fold RMSEs; original candidate order breaks ties. Each arm tuned independently.
scaling: Training-only unweighted StandardScaler for ridge/NN features, target centering for ridge and training-only y standardization for NN.
controls: Byte-identical shared outer/inner split arrays and seed triplets. All other model settings and grids unchanged. Both panels separately tuned using inner training/validation only.
baseline: Reuse 20 verified 64-gene ridge and 20 verified 64-gene NN models. Fit both five-gene models from scratch on each outer training set, with separate inner hyperparameter selection; 40 new + 40 reused outer models.
feature_selection: The five genes were explicitly fixed by the user after prior held-out importance analysis of the same 20 splits. They are NOT selected independently within each outer training set.
selection_limitation: Earlier test responses influenced the choice of this five-gene panel. Reusing the same outer splits gives an exploratory post-selection comparison, not independent validation of feature selection. Inner hyperparameter tuning does not remove this selection bias; a fresh response cohort or prospectively reserved test set is required for confirmatory validation.
metric_notes: Mean of per-repeat outer-test scores. Macro23 RMSE equally averages all 23 held-in lineages; macro19 RMSE uses the 19 cohort lineages with n>=10. Per-lineage Spearman is descriptive and undefined for one-point/constant test subsets; no macro Spearman is used because tiny held-out subsets make it unstable.

uncertainty.unit: Paired whole-lineage bootstrap shared across models and all 20 split-specific test sets; conditional on predictions, no refitting, no multiplicity adjustment. Repeated test sets overlap and are not independent biological replicates. These conditional intervals also do not adjust for the prior five-gene selection.

equivalence: No equivalence/noninferiority margin or confirmatory equivalence test is defined. An interval crossing zero does not establish equivalence.
limitations: Exploratory reuse of the cell-line cohort; evaluates new cell lines from represented lineages, not unseen-lineage transfer. No external validation. Rare-lineage test subsets are tiny; one Ampulla training line cannot be an inner validation point. Panel/model comparisons reuse this cohort after earlier exploration; no multiplicity adjustment or independent external validation.
